{{Top|leg}}
The '''shatter beam''' was an arm-mounted energy weapon used in [[Juggernaut war droid]]s during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]].

When fired, the weapon could create a steady stream of coherent energy for several minutes, not unlike a [[composite-beam laser]]. The energy discharge carried considerable kinetic force, and was capable of tearing a [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] door off its frame.
